question: The total number of bishops in a chess game is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**four.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a standard chess game, there are **four bishops**, two for each player.
 
• Each player starts with one bishop on a light square and one bishop on a dark square.
